title: Hippocampal astrocytic sequences emerge during learning and memory recall
goal: Reproduce the source predictive-density comparison for inferred astrocytic peak times across conditioning, recall contexts A/B and the original recall sex strata, retaining all four original distribution families, their common observation support, and the source likelihood and WAIC conventions. Evaluate any candidate improvement on the same qualified result with justified uncertainty. Preserve the source peak-distribution and parameter evidence needed to interpret near-uniform fits; report habituation, sequence ordering and temporal-organization findings separately unless a claim expressly depends on them. Verify correspondence between the May 2026 preprint and the registered final paper before admitting a final-paper result.
